extraction.notes: IRT reports FFO and CFFO (Core FFO) only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. Used the three-month Sep 30, 2023 column of the Statements of Operations, FFO & CORE FFO table (seq 31). Diluted share count is the 'Weighted-average shares and units outstanding' figure of 230,444,945, shown in thousands as 230,444.945; it reproduces $0.31 FFO/share (70,957/230,445) and $0.30 CFFO/share (69,003/230,445). Prepayment (gains) penalties and merger/restructuring lines are dashes for the quarter and were omitted. Recurring capex is from the MD&A ('$5.3 million', rounded, so 5,300 in thousands is approximate); it is not subtracted in CFFO. The impairment line in the reconciliation is 11,268 in the current quarter (Chicago held-for-sale property).
